name: King Slime
summon: Slime Crown (20 Gel + Gold/Platinum Crown at a Demon Altar), or by defeating 150 slimes during a Slime Rain.
description: A giant slime wearing a crown. The most approachable boss and a gentle introduction to boss fights.
strategy: Keep moving to avoid contact damage and hit him from range. He splits into smaller slimes on defeat.

name: Eye of Cthulhu
summon: Suspicious Looking Eye (found in chests, or 6 Lens at a Demon/Crimson Altar) at night. May also spawn naturally once you reach 200 HP.
description: A flying, bloodshot eye and the classic first real boss. Speeds up and charges as its health drops.
strategy: Use an arena of platforms and ranged weapons. Dodge its dashes in phase two; the Shield of Cthulhu dash (Expert) makes this trivial.

name: Eater of Worlds
summon: Worm Food (15 Vile Powder + 30 Rotten Chunk at a Demon Altar), or break 3 Shadow Orbs in the Corruption.
description: A colossal burrowing worm that splits into smaller worms when segments are destroyed. The Corruption's boss.
strategy: Piercing weapons shred its many segments. Fight on the surface or in a large open cavern to avoid being swarmed.

name: Brain of Cthulhu
summon: Bloody Spine (15 Vertebrae + 30 Vicious Powder at a Crimson Altar), or break 3 Crimson Hearts.
description: A floating brain surrounded by Creepers. The Crimson's boss and the Eater of Worlds' counterpart.
strategy: Kill the Creepers first to expose the vulnerable brain, then burst it down. A strong piercing or AoE weapon helps.

name: Queen Bee
summon: Abeemination (Hive blocks + Honey Block + Stinger + Bottled Honey at an Altar), or break a Larva in a Jungle Hive.
description: The queen of the Jungle's giant bees, fought inside the Bee Hives of the Underground Jungle.
strategy: Fight in an open area to avoid her charging attacks. Her summoned bees are deadly in enclosed spaces.

name: Deerclops
summon: Deer Thing (3 Flinx Fur + 5 Demonite/Crimtane Ore + 1 Lens at an Altar) in the Snow biome.
description: A Don't Starve crossover boss. A one-eyed winter beast with powerful ice attacks and flying debris.
strategy: Dodge the shadowy hands it summons and keep out of its melee range. It can only be fought in the Snow biome.

name: Skeletron
summon: Speak to the Old Man at the Dungeon entrance at night. Defeating him unlocks the Dungeon.
description: The guardian of the Dungeon. A giant skeleton whose spinning skull attack punishes those who enter unprepared.
strategy: Destroy the hands first to lower the head's defense, then circle and attack the head. Fight before dawn or he becomes enraged.

name: Wall of Flesh
summon: Throw a Guide Voodoo Doll into Underworld lava while the Guide is alive. This permanently enters Hardmode.
description: The final pre-Hardmode boss and the gatekeeper to Hardmode. A towering wall of flesh that chases you across the Underworld.
strategy: Build a long bridge and run away while firing behind you. Kill the Hungry and the eyes that attack, and never stop moving.

name: Queen Slime
summon: Gelatin Crystal found in the Underground Hallow (use during the day in the Hallow).
description: The first Hardmode boss. A crystalline slime monarch who fires bouncing gel and summons crystal slimes.
strategy: Stay mobile to avoid her bouncing projectiles and clear the crystal minions quickly so they don't swarm you.

name: The Twins
summon: Mechanical Eye (3 Lens + Iron/Lead Bar + 6 Souls of Light at a Mythril Anvil) at night.
description: Two mechanical eyes — Retinazer and Spazmatism — that mimic the Eye of Cthulhu with lasers and cursed flames.
strategy: Focus one twin at a time (usually Spazmatism first). A long sky bridge and high mobility are essential.

name: The Destroyer
summon: Mechanical Worm (6 Rotten Chunks/Vertebrae + Iron/Lead Bar + 6 Souls of Night at a Mythril Anvil) at night.
description: A mechanical Eater of Worlds that tears through the ground, firing lasers from every segment.
strategy: Piercing weapons and AoE damage tear through its long body. Build high platforms and watch for its laser barrage.

name: Skeletron Prime
summon: Mechanical Skull (30 Bones + Iron/Lead Bar + 3 Souls of Light + 3 Souls of Night at a Mythril Anvil) at night.
description: A mechanized Skeletron armed with a cannon, saw, vice, and laser. The most dangerous of the mechanical trio.
strategy: Destroy its four weapon arms before focusing the head. Fight before dawn to avoid its enraged state.

name: Plantera
summon: Break a Plantera's Bulb in the Underground Jungle (after all three mechanical bosses are defeated).
description: A monstrous jungle flower that becomes enraged if you leave the Underground Jungle. Unlocks the Jungle Temple.
strategy: Clear a large open arena in the Jungle and circle around her, dodging seeds and spiky balls. Bring mobility and healing.

name: Golem
summon: Use a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the Lihzahrd Altar inside the Jungle Temple.
description: The Temple's guardian, a stone colossus that attacks with fists, fireballs, and a detaching laser head.
strategy: Destroy the head and fists, then dodge the jumping body. A confined arena makes this fight cramped but manageable.

name: Empress of Light
summon: Kill a Prismatic Lacewing in the Hallow at night (released from a Lacewing butterfly).
description: A radiant Hallow boss of pure light. Defeat her during the day for the ultimate challenge and the Terraprisma.
strategy: Her attacks are all dodgeable with practice. Fighting at night is easier; a daytime victory requires a flawless run.

name: Duke Fishron
summon: Fish with a Truffle Worm as bait in the Ocean.
description: A shark-pig-duke hybrid that charges through the air at terrifying speed. One of Hardmode's hardest fights.
strategy: Use fast wings and dodge in wide circles. Avoid his tornado and bubble attacks, and keep damaging him consistently.

name: Lunatic Cultist
summon: Defeat the four Cultists at the Dungeon entrance after Golem is defeated.
description: The leader of the cultists who guards the Lunar Events. Defeating him triggers the Celestial Pillars.
strategy: Attack the real cultist, not his duplicates — hitting a decoy spawns a Phantasm Dragon. Learn his clone pattern.

name: Moon Lord
summon: Defeat all four Celestial Pillars, or use a Celestial Sigil crafted from their fragments.
description: The final boss of Terraria. A cosmic god whose eyes and core must be destroyed to claim victory.
strategy: Take out the eyes on his hands and head, then the core. A long asphalt skybridge and strong mobility are standard tactics.
